notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
description:
Activate Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary.
Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, triggering Tatyova twice and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw two cards and gain two life.
Repeat.
